policy: These records describe observed Netlify project and deploy metadata. Hidden edge-function behavior must be preserved or explicitly replaced before a project is consolidated or retired.

projects.name: dev-in-portfolio
projects.notes: Large production bundle. The Reforged root build is intended to make this deployment deterministic from source.

projects.name: dev-in-portfolio-home
projects.notes: Publishes the home/ section copy. Do not retire until hidden edge behavior and public routes are compared.

projects.name: dev-in-portfolio-apps
projects.notes: Production is pinned to the April 18 pre-console architecture and does not include the June Apps console, Vault, or compiled application work.

projects.name: dev-in-portfolio-utilities
projects.notes: Retained as a standalone destination while its navigation and hidden edge behavior are reconciled.

projects.name: dev-in-portfolio-about
projects.notes: Retained as a standalone destination while its navigation and hidden edge behavior are reconciled.

projects.name: dev-in-portfolio-contact
projects.notes: Retained as a standalone destination while its navigation and hidden edge behavior are reconciled.

projects.name: dev-in-portfolio-capabilities
projects.notes: Pinned to a separate April branch. The main build delegates /capabilities/ here and does not intentionally modify the protected page. productionCommit is preserved as the observed prefix because the full commit was not exposed by the connector response.

hardStops: Do not retire a standalone project until its hidden edge-function behavior is identified or replaced.
Do not repoint the protected Capabilities project during the foundation pass.
Do not treat the stale Apps project as evidence that current Apps routes are deployed.
Do not infer build settings that the Netlify project API does not expose.
